data.name: Aleida
data.gender_notes: Aleida is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aleida is derived from the Latin word ‘aledus’, meaning ‘helper’. This name is often given to those who are seen as bringers of light and purity into the world. The name Aleida carries the meaning “Helper, Light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Aleida usually hope their child will grow to embody helper, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are called to serve and uplift others. Aleida is a reminder of the importance of being a light in the darkness for those around us.
data.etymology: Aleida belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helper, Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aleida total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: אלידה
in_hebrew.meaning: אלידה היא שמו של נדבן או שושנת הגן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלידה מקורה בשפה הגרמנית ומשמעותה 'שושנת הגן' או 'נדבן'. השם הוא גרסה של השם אדלייד, שמקורו בשם הגרמני 'אדאל הייד', שמשמעותו 'אציל' ו'גן'. השם אלידה מופיע בשימוש נדיר בקרב שמות נוצרים, אך הוא נושא משמעות יפה וקונוטציות חיוביות.

in_greek.name: Αλειδα
in_greek.meaning: Αλειδα σημαίνει το ευγενές ή το τριαντάφυλλο του κήπου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αλειδα είναι μια παραλλαγή του ονόματος Αδελαΐδα, που προέρχεται από το γερμανικό όνομα 'Adalheid', που σημαίνει 'ευγενές' και 'κήπος'. Το όνομα αυτό χρησιμοποιήθηκε στην Ευρώπη κατά τον Μεσαίωνα και ήταν δημοφιλές μεταξύ των βασιλικών οικογενειών. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Αλειδα συμβολίζει την πνευματική ανάπτυξη και την ομορφιά.

in_latin.name: Aleida
in_latin.meaning: Aleida means noble or garden rose
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Aleida originates from the Germanic name 'Adalheid', which consists of 'adal' meaning 'noble' and 'heid' meaning 'garden' or 'heath'. The name was popularized in Europe during the Middle Ages and was borne by several saints and nobles. In Christian tradition, Aleida symbolizes spiritual growth and beauty.

in_english.name: Aleida
